title: ESPECIALISTA DE DADOS
description:
Cargo: ESPECIALISTA DE DADOS


Já pensou em trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas de Tecnologia do Brasil?

Então a CAST é o lugar certo para você! 😉


Todas as nossas vagas são afirmativas 🦼✊ 🤱 ️ !!!


Local de Atuação: Brasil

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto


O QUE BUSCAMOS

Estamos em busca de um profissional responsável por projetar, implantar e operar a infraestrutura de nuvem que sustenta a plataforma de dados, garantindo conectividade, identidade, armazenamento, criptografia, disponibilidade, observabilidade e controle de custos, com atuação em ambientes híbridos AWS e on-premises.


Que possua conhecimentos e experiências em:

✔️ Domínio de fundamentos AWS, incluindo redes, IAM, armazenamento, criptografia, monitoramento, alta disponibilidade, backup e recuperação;

✔️ Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), preferencialmente Terraform, gestão de estado, módulos reutilizáveis e pipelines de mudanças;

✔️ Conhecimentos sólidos de TCP/IP, DNS, roteamento, firewalls, proxies, balanceadores, VPN/Direct Connect e troubleshooting de conectividade;

✔️ Experiência com práticas de segurança em nuvem, incluindo menor privilégio, segregação de funções, gestão de segredos, rotação de credenciais e hardening;

✔️ Administração de ambientes AWS utilizados pelo Databricks, incluindo VPCs, subnets, security groups, S3, IAM Roles, KMS, PrivateLink e endpoints privados;

✔️ Experiência com automação de provisionamento de workspaces e recursos compartilhados utilizando Terraform, com separação por órgão e ambiente;

✔️ Conhecimento em conectividade híbrida com bancos Oracle e outros serviços on-premises, incluindo proxies, rotas, resolução de nomes e monitoramento de disponibilidade;

✔️ Experiência na gestão de credenciais e identidades técnicas utilizadas por pipelines, service principals e integrações entre Azure DevOps, Databricks e AWS;

✔️ Conhecimento em observabilidade de infraestrutura, incluindo alertas, logs, métricas e runbooks de resposta;

✔️ Conhecimento em FinOps, incluindo tagging, budgets, análise de consumo, right-sizing e identificação de desperdícios em computação, armazenamento e tráfego;

✔️ Experiência ou conhecimento em migração de componentes on-premises e Kubernetes/Rancher para serviços em nuvem, garantindo continuidade e segurança.


BENEFÍCIOS PARA TODOS

Recarregue suas energias com o auxílio-alimentação.

🚘 Facilitamos seu caminho para o trabalho com o vale-transporte.

🚑 Cuidar de você é nosso compromisso: plano de saúde para sua tranquilidade.

Cuidar de quem cuida é essencial! Com o Programa Baby CAST, nossas mamães recebem um Kit Maternidade CASTLOVERS, preparado com carinho para celebrar a chegada do bebê. (Benefício disponível para vagas elegíveis.)


BENEFÍCIOS PARA VOCÊ ESCOLHER

🦷 Sorria com confiança: nosso plano odontológico cuida do seu bem-estar bucal.

⚕️ Cuide da sua saúde com mais praticidade: com o Dr. Alper, você tem acesso a teleconsultas sem coparticipação, cashback na compra de medicamentos e mapeamento de saúde.

🩺 Com o Starbem, você e até quatro dependentes contam com teleconsultas gratuitas com psicólogos, nutricionistas, clínico geral e médicos especialistas.

️ ♀️ Transforme seu bem-estar: com Wellhub, você tem acesso a academias e atividades físicas em todo lugar.

🧠 Seu bem-estar mental é nossa prioridade: apoio psicológico disponível.

Seja seu melhor com nossas iniciativas de bem-estar. Nos escritórios da CAST, disponibilizamos frutas para tornar a rotina mais leve e saudável.

Aproveite nosso crédito consignado para realizar seus sonhos com segurança e praticidade.

Com o Clube de Descontos economize mais com nossos descontos exclusivos para colaboradores.


E TEM MAIS! DESENVOLVA SUA CARREIRA

Temos a CAST Academy recheada de cursos on-line, e parcerias educacionais para cursos de Graduação e Idiomas (United Idiomas) com super descontos.


E aí, topa ser um #CASTLOVER ?

title: Email Marketing Designer
description:
Email Marketing Designer

Full-Time | 40 hrs/week | Remote and US business hours | Long-Term Contract


About the Role

Our client, a high-growth, 8-figure DTC apparel brand, is looking for a highly experienced Graphic Designer to join their email marketing and paid-ads creative team full-time. This role plays a key part in executing high-frequency campaigns that reflect the brand's voice and drive results across email and paid channels.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-quality email graphics and layouts in Figma, aligned with campaign objectives
  • Translate monthly marketing briefs into compelling visual executions
  • Prepare and integrate final designs into Klaviyo for email campaign flows
  • Work closely with the email marketing team to execute lifecycle campaigns
  • Ensure visuals reflect brand voice and customer nuance
  • Support paid media creative assets
  • Support social media graphics and promotional assets
  • Contribute to creative execution for product launches and seasonal campaigns
  • Execute quickly and efficiently in a high-frequency campaign environment
  • Apply strategic thinking to every email — including CTA hierarchy, personalization, and urgency — not just visual execution
  • Own the full range of lifecycle email types: welcome/onboarding, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, cross-sell, and win-back


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional graphic design experience, with a strong focus on email marketing or lifecycle campaigns
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma (primary design tool for this role)
  • Strong attention to detail and brand alignment
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven DTC environment
  • Ability to collaborate closely with lifecycle/email marketing teams
  • Strong execution discipline, consistency, and speed of delivery
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce email marketing strategy (CTA hierarchy, personalization, urgency, friction reduction) — not purely visual design
  • Experience supporting eCommerce brands at scale, ideally $500K+ in monthly revenue
  • Fluent English communication (written and verbal) for daily collaboration with a US-based team


Nice to Have

  • Experience preparing and integrating designs into Klaviyo
  • Familiarity with Canva as a secondary design tool


Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a seasoned designer with deep, hands-on experience creating high-quality email marketing creatives — not a generalist. They work confidently in Figma, understand how their designs flow into email platforms like Klaviyo, and take ownership of their output from concept to final asset. They're comfortable juggling multiple campaigns at once and thrive in the rhythm of a fast-paced DTC brand.

title: Senior Business Analyst / Arquiteto de Soluções SAP S/4HANA Cloud
description:
🚀 Senior Business Analyst / Arquiteto de Soluções SAP S/4HANA Cloud


São Paulo/SP (Onboarding presencial em SP, não contempla reembolso de despesas)

Atuação remota após integração/Onboarding


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir workshops e reuniões com as áreas de negócio para levantamento de requisitos.
  • Mapear processos atuais e identificar oportunidades de padronização no SAP S/4HANA Cloud.
  • Realizar análises Fit-Gap e reduzir dependências de customizações.
  • Elaborar RFPs, documentação funcional e escopos de projetos.
  • Atuar como ponte entre usuários, consultores SAP e equipes de tecnologia.
  • Apoiar a definição de soluções alinhadas às melhores práticas SAP.


Requisitos

✅ Experiência sólida como Business Analyst, Solution Architect ou Consultor SAP Sênior .

✅ Experiência em projetos de SAP S/4HANA Cloud .

✅ Forte conhecimento de processos de negócio end-to-end.

✅ Vivência em levantamento de requisitos, workshops e interação com stakeholders.

✅ Experiência em elaboração de RFPs , documentação funcional e análises Fit-Gap.

✅ Conhecimento de SAP Best Practices e abordagem Clean Core .


Perfil

⭐ Forte senso de ownership.

⭐ Profissional autônomo, pragmático e consultivo.

⭐ Excelente comunicação com áreas usuárias.

⭐ Capacidade de influenciar e conduzir discussões de negócio.

⭐ Visão sistêmica e foco em simplificação de processos.

title: Director of Strategic Partnerships
description:
ABOUT ELIFE

Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, FinTechs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.


THE ROLE

We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.

This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding
  • Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform
  • Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time
  • Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries
  • Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM
  • Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships


WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise partnerships experience
  • Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM
  • Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets
  • Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end
  • Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, DiDi, MercadoPago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, iFood or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks
  • Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus
  • Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required
  • Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies
  • Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes
  • Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously
  • Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia


WHAT WE OFFER

title: Senior AI Agent Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research

coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.


The role

We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the

evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.

The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and

inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a

person reviews before anything happens with it.

Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,

traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.

You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've

shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea

whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.


What you'll do

• Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling,

included but not limited to the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK,

LangGraph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.

• Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems

are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation.

• Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect

entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch.

• Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to

Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses.

Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task.

• Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence

signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.

• Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.

Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both.

• Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as

regression tests.

• Compare models against each other (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt

strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.

• Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means

generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will

eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.

• Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to

you.


Required Qualifications:

• 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real

users touched.

• You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about

a multi-step run.

• You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and

turned them into something an agent can call reliably.

• You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against

a structured source of truth.

• You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.

• You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and

what to do about it.

• You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question

being asked instead of a nearby one.

• You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval

for them.

• You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.

• You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the

furthest east we can go.

You might currently be titled

AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI

Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI

Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll

go on what you've shipped.


Preferred Qualifications:

• You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking.

• You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, LangGraph, or the OpenAI

Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong.

• You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance.

• You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences.

• You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.


This is a fully remote, full-time permanent position available to candidates located within the New York (ET) through Western Europe time zones, with flexible working hours to support collaboration across regions.

title: Junior Spanish Recruiter
description:
Location: São Paulo, SP or Bragança Paulista, SP

Work Model: Hybrid or Remote


About the Role

We are looking for a Junior Recruiter to join our team and support our staffing and outsourcing operations .


This role is ideal for someone who is building a career in recruitment and enjoys connecting with people, identifying talent, and building candidate relationships . title: Online Business English Teacher
description:
About the job

Company Description C-Leader English Academy helps professionals and executives develop the business English they need to perform in real-world corporate situations. The academy offers highly personalized programs tailored to each learner’s professional context, goals, and communication challenges, avoiding generic classes and focusing on efficiency. Its method combines realistic business scenarios, strategic communication practice, and direct application to daily work routines. This approach builds confidence, clarity, and measurable impact in the workplace. C-Leader is ideal for those seeking structured, purposeful, and fast-paced language development that supports leadership and global positioning.

Role Description

The Online Business English Teacher will deliver high-quality business-focused English lessons to professionals and executives, using C-Leader’s personalized methodology. Day-to-day tasks include preparing tailored lesson plans based on learners’ industries and roles, conducting live online classes, and focusing on communication skills for meetings, presentations, negotiations, and leadership contexts. The teacher will assess learner progress, provide detailed feedback, and adjust content to address evolving communication needs and business scenarios. Responsibilities also include maintaining accurate records of sessions, collaborating with the academic team to refine materials, and ensuring a consistent, professional learning experience. This is an online work position, and is open only to non-Brazilian candidates.


Requirements/Qualifications: (Please ONLY apply if you MEET ALL the following requisites)

-ACTIVE CNPJ is essential and mandatory

-FLUENT ENGLISH at teaching level with excellent grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation suitable for business environments.

-International TEACHING CERTIFICATION or graduation in Education, Languages, Linguistics, Business, or a related field; international teaching certificates (e.g., CELTA, TESOL).

-Proven solid EXPERIENCE teaching English to professionals or executives, with a focus on business or corporate communication.

-Proven experience with ONLINE TEACHING

-Ability to design and deliver personalized lesson plans based on learners’ job roles, industries, and real business situations.

-Skills in facilitating communication practice for meetings, presentations, negotiations, and leadership interactions.

-Comfort with online teaching tools, learning platforms, and digital resources to support interactive and engaging classes.

-Strong interpersonal skills, cultural awareness, and the ability to work with diverse, high-level professionals in a respectful, inclusive manner.

-Know how to use Google Meet and Notion for teaching

-Having a good computer setup and a stable internet connection

title: HR Business Partner - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role: We are looking for a HR Business Partner to join our Human Resources team. We are looking for proactive, dynamic people and team players, with great organizational capacity, accustomed to handle multiple tasks and with marked attention to details. It is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!


Key responsibilities:


- Hold regular meetings with the respective business units and management, providing guidance on HR issues.

- Analyze trends and metrics related to the level of rotation in order to develop solutions, programs and policies to increase retention.

- Stay updated on the legal requirements related to the daily management of employees, giving priority to the reduction of legal risks and guaranteeing regulatory compliance.

- Provide guidance and assistance in interpreting HR policies.

- Solve complex problems of various kinds related to employees.

- Assist international employees with expatriation assignments and HR-related matters.


Requirements:


- Previous experience in similar positions within the area.

- Knowledge of the labor regulations of Argentina and Latin America.

- Communication skills.

- Experience in the IT industry or regional responsibility (desirable).

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Electrical BIM/VDC Coordinator
description:
At Consultores de Empresas , we are looking for an Electrical BIM/VDC Coordinator !

We are seeking a professional with experience in BIM/VDC, electrical modeling, and construction project coordination to join a team working on highly complex commercial projects.


Key Responsibilities

  • Interpret and analyze construction documentation for electrical systems.
  • Design and model conduit systems according to design and constructability criteria.
  • Develop and manage LOD 400 electrical models in Revit .
  • Perform clash detection and resolution using Navisworks and Revizto .
  • Coordinate the electrical model with different disciplines and project teams.
  • Produce sleeve drawings, embedded points, and coordinate shop drawings.
  • Ensure model accuracy and compliance with applicable codes.
  • Resolve modeling issues and provide technical solutions.
  • Support field operations through remote coordination.
  • Occasionally collaborate on mechanical/MEP and process piping modeling tasks.


Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in BIM/VDC and construction modeling .
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in electrical project coordination .
  • Experience in electrical trades/installations.
  • Revit mandatory , with strong experience in detailed electrical modeling.
  • Experience working with LOD 350–400 electrical models .
  • Experience interpreting construction documentation.
  • Knowledge of Navisworks and/or Revizto .
  • Knowledge of AutoCAD and BIM 360 is a plus.
  • Understanding of MEP systems and their integration into modeling workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving and coordination skills.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in remote environments.


Project Experience

Experience in the following projects is a plus:

  • ️ Data Centers / Critical Infrastructure
  • Healthcare Facilities
  • Educational Institutions
  • Semiconductor Manufacturing Plants
  • Commercial and Retail Projects


We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Excellent communication and strong remote work capabilities.
  • A proactive and autonomous approach.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and a strong focus on quality.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Interest in adopting new tools and industry practices.


Location: Latin America | Remote

If you have experience in BIM/VDC and electrical modeling in Revit , we want to hear from you!

title: Administrador(a) de Dados Senior
description:
Buscamos um(a) Administrador(a) de Dados Sênior com experiência sólida em administração e modelagem de dados, conhecimento em negócios bancários e atuação com framework BIAN, arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA), Apache Kafka e governança de eventos .

O profissional atuará na modelagem, administração e governança de dados e eventos, trabalhando de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, analistas de negócio e equipes de desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades

  • Administrar e modelar dados nos níveis conceitual, lógico e físico , alinhados às necessidades de negócio e aos requisitos regulatórios;
  • Aplicar os princípios do framework BIAN na modelagem de dados, serviços bancários e integrações sistêmicas;
  • Atuar na governança de dados transacionais e orientados a eventos , definindo padrões, políticas e melhores práticas;
  • Definir, versionar e governar eventos em Apache Kafka , incluindo tópicos, contratos de dados e fluxos de publicação e consumo;
  • Projetar, estruturar e manter schemas AVRO , garantindo compatibilidade, versionamento e aderência aos padrões corporativos;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de qualidade de dados, catálogo de dados, linhagem e metadados corporativos ;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos de solução, arquitetos corporativos, analistas de negócio e times de desenvolvimento ;
  • Atuar junto às esteiras CI/CD , apoiando a automação de deploys e validações de modelos, eventos e schemas;
  • Documentar e manter atualizados os ativos de dados, eventos e artefatos de governança .

Requisitos

Experiência e conhecimentos técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em administração e modelagem de dados ;
  • Conhecimento de negócios bancários , principalmente em assuntos como Cheque Especial, Conta e Pagamentos ;
  • Conhecimento prático e aplicável do framework BIAN ;
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) e Apache Kafka ;
  • Conhecimento em governança de eventos , incluindo definição de contratos, versionamento e políticas de compatibilidade;
  • Experiência na modelagem e gestão de schemas AVRO (Schema Registry) ;
  • Conhecimento em esteiras CI/CD ;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de modelagem de dados como Erwin, PowerDesigner ou similares ;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL ;
  • Entendimento e aplicação de normas de compliance e privacidade de dados , incluindo LGPD e GDPR .

Formação

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas .

title: Telecom Procurement Manager - Brazil(A222022)
description:
Responsibilities:

- Explore all relevant telecommunications resources (VOIP, SIP trunk, SMS channel) in target countries, industries, and target markets

- Maintain good relationships with telecom resource suppliers/ telecom operators

- Attend telecom trade meetings periodically

- Work closely with the team to integrate telecom resources into our product/platform


Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

- +5 Years of practical experience in exploring/purchasing telecom resources. (sip trunk, sms channel)

- Great passion for technology products and the telecom industry

- Good at critical reasoning and multi-tasking implementation

- Good communicative skills and business acumen

- Passionate and result-oriented

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office

- Proficiency in English.


Preferred Qualifications:

- Work experience in telecom operators.

- Five years or more of practical experience in telecom resource sales and purchasing

- Good understanding of industry research

- Successful track record in maintaining supplier relationships and people management

- Good interpersonal and teamwork skills.


About AI Rudder

AI Rudder is a conversational AI company on a mission to transform how businesses communicate with their customers — across voice and digital channels that feel genuinely human.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Singapore, we're building technologies that bridge languages, enhance understanding, and enable meaningful human–machine communication at scale.

Today, we serve 500+ enterprise clients globally processing 50 million calls daily and having delivered more than 8 billion calls to date.

Most recently, we have raised $50M in a Series B fundraising from leading global investors including Tiger Global, Peak XV Partners, and Cathay Innovation.


How We Work

AI-first: AI isn't a tool we reach for. It's the default we start from. Every team, every workflow: AI-first.

Global Collaboration: We operate globally and work as one team. Distance is a logistics problem, not a cultural one. We build the habits that make distributed teams actually work.

Communication Principle: Simple, Trust, Transparent. We remove unnecessary complexity so people can focus on what matters most.


What We Offer

Learning & Development: Continuous learning through real projects, knowledge sharing session, mentorship, and cross-functional collaboration.

Performance Recognition: Regular performance reviews, feedback, and opportunities for career progression.

Global Exposure: Collaborate with international teams, global rotations, and work with global enterprise customers.

Meaningful Impact: Build AI solutions that create real value for businesses around the world.

Ownership & Autonomy: Freedom to take initiative and drive outcomes.

Team Engagement: Team Building, Local & Global Gatherings & Local Events Celebration.


AI Rudder is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants.

title: Finance Analyst - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are seeking a Finance Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Finance Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Perform research and gather documentation to compile comprehensive reports delivering operational reports, and transactional tasks.

- Work with banking/financial entities, international agencies, or government officials.

- Assist in vendor and client registration, purchasing, and accounts payable processes.

- Data processing: responsible for updating records in the company system.

- Assist in the department's programs, projects, and processes.

- Assist in the preparation of monthly financial reports.

- Assist in tracking due dates and compliance with US tax returns and other legal requirements.


Requirements:


- 3+ years of experience working in finance areas.

- Expertise with web-based tools.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Interpersonal and presentation skills.

- Organized and detail-oriented.

- Proven organizational skills.

- Advanced English, both spoken and written (a must).


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Native or Bilingual German & Japanese Teachers | Freelance
description:
LingoGalaxy is looking for native or bilingual German- or Japanese-speaking teachers to deliver personalized online lessons to children and teenagers.


You do not need to be registered as a freelancer to work with LingoGalaxy.

All lessons are fully online, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere. Previous experience teaching children is preferred but not required .


What We Offer
  • Fully remote teaching — work from anywhere.
  • Flexible scheduling — minimum availability of 12 hours per week during our peak teaching hours:
  • 16:00–20:00 CET for European students
  • 16:00–20:00 EST for US students
  • Dedicated HR support — our HR team is available throughout your collaboration to assist with student-related, scheduling, technical, or other work-related issues.


Creative Freedom in Your Teaching

We encourage teachers to use their own teaching resources and create engaging, age-appropriate lesson presentations tailored to each student's needs.

This is an opportunity to use your own teaching style, creativity, and ideas to develop lessons that work well for your students and that you genuinely enjoy teaching. We also provide guidance and resources when needed.


Compensation
  • €8 per 30-minute lesson
  • €14 per 60-minute lesson


Requirements
  • Native or bilingual German or Japanese proficiency.
  • Availability for at least 12 hours per week during the specified peak hours .
  • Ability and willingness to create engaging, age-appropriate lesson materials.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable setup for online teaching.


If you are looking for a flexible online German or Japanese teaching opportunity where you can use your own teaching style and creativity, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Business Intelligence Partner - Remote Work
description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.


Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.


When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.


Talent Acquisition Senior Auditor at BairesDev


As a Senior Auditor , you'll play a key role in ensuring the quality, consistency, and reliability of recruitment audits. You'll handle complex and high-impact cases, review and guide junior auditors, and help align evaluation criteria across the team. This role offers the chance to make a real impact by improving the quality of hiring processes, working on meaningful and complex cases, shaping audit standards, and helping both processes and people grow through clear feedback and continuous improvement.


What You'll Do:


- Execute complex, sensitive, and high-impact audits.

- Supervise and review Junior Auditors' evaluations.

- Lead calibration calls and standardize criteria across the audit team.


What we are looking for:


- 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance roles.

- Proven experience auditing complex and high-impact roles, including senior profiles, closers, and specialized positions.

- Hands-on experience supervising and calibrating Junior Auditors to ensure consistency and accuracy across evaluations.

- Advanced proficiency in English.


Nice to have:


- Experience in Talent Acquisition.

- Experience working with high-volume recruitment processes.

- Experience in data analysis and SQL.


How we do make your work (and your life) easier:


- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and national holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.


Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

title: Head of Risk
description:
Head of Credit Risk

We’re partnering with a fast-growing, profitable fintech transforming how small businesses in Brazil access credit and working capital. The company has built a highly automated, data-driven credit platform and is entering its next phase of significant scale and product expansion.


The role:

  • Own credit strategy, policy, portfolio performance, and credit P&L
  • Identify opportunities to sustainably scale the existing credit business
  • Partner closely with Product to design and launch new credit products
  • Serve as a strategic counterpart to Data Science/modeling leadership
  • Set direction in a highly entrepreneurial, fast-moving environment
  • Build and develop a high-performing risk organization as the business scales


Ideal background:

  • Launched a new credit product and successfully scaled it
  • Managed a large-scale credit portfolio with meaningful P&L and policy ownership
  • Experience managing multiple credit products simultaneously
  • Strong technical fluency across underwriting, modeling, and data science
  • First-principles thinker who can challenge conventional credit assumptions
  • Proven ability to operate in high-growth environments with strategic ambiguity
  • Strong track record of attracting and developing top talent
  • Brazil / Portuguese fluency strongly preferred
company: CTB1LLC, a boutique talent and placement company

title: Digital Designer (Marketing)
description:
Overview

Wunderdogs is an independent creative agency with a growing (20+) distributed team across the U.S., Canada and Europe. We provide beginning-to-end strategy, design and production services to forward-thinking brands in the technology space, from startups to established companies.

We're looking for a Digital Designer (Marketing) to join our team and work primarily with our retainer clients. Unlike project-based work, you'll develop deep, ongoing relationships with a portfolio of clients, becoming an extension of their marketing teams and developing an intimate understanding of their brands, audiences, and business goals.

You'll report to both the Design Team Lead and Head of Creative and Strategy, working across a wide range of marketing assets. This role requires a designer who thrives on variety, works quickly without sacrificing quality, and has a deep understanding of marketing asset creation across digital channels.

Key Responsibilities
Marketing Asset Creation
  • Designing social media content across platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter/X, Facebook), including static posts, carousels, and stories
  • Creating webinar and event graphics, including promotional banners, registration pages, presentation templates, and recap assets
  • Developing one-pagers, sell sheets, and product/feature overviews
  • Designing email headers, newsletter templates, and digital campaign assets
  • Creating infographics, data visualizations, and report layouts
  • Designing blog graphics, featured images, and content marketing visuals
  • Producing landing page designs and website banners
  • Creating presentation decks for sales, investors, and internal use
  • Designing trade show and event collateral (booth graphics, handouts, signage)
  • Adapting and resizing assets for multiple formats and platforms
Brand Stewardship
  • Maintaining brand consistency across all touchpoints for assigned clients
  • Building and maintaining template libraries and asset repositories
  • Contributing to design system development and documentation
  • Evolving client brands within established guidelines while keeping them fresh


Collaboration & Process
  • Working under the supervision of the Design Team Lead while maintaining direct communication with leadership
  • Collaborating closely with Account Managers to understand client priorities and deadlines
  • Managing multiple client requests simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail
  • Participating in client calls and incorporating feedback quickly
  • Working efficiently within retainer hour allocations
Key KPIs
  • Operational Efficiency: Deviation from estimates <10%
  • Client Satisfaction (CSAT): Average score 4.7+
  • Internal Quality Score: Average score 4.7+
  • Client Creative Feedback: Average score 4.7+
  • Turnaround Time: Meeting SLAs for retainer deliverables
Requirements
  • 3-5+ years of experience in marketing design, preferably at an agency or in-house marketing team
  • Deep experience with marketing asset types: social media graphics, webinar materials, one-pagers, email templates, presentations, infographics
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms and their design requirements/best practices
  • Expert proficiency in Figma (primary tool)
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)
  • Proficiency with AI tools
  • Experience with motion/animation tools a plus (After Effects, Lottie)
  • Ability to work quickly and efficiently without sacrificing quality
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain brand consistency
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple client accounts
  • Comfortable with remote collaboration via Slack, video calls, and project management tools
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating range across marketing asset types
Nice to Have
  • Experience working with B2B technology brands
  • Basic motion design / animation skills
  • Experience with HubSpot, Marketo, or other marketing automation platforms
  • Understanding of conversion-focused design principles
  • Experience building and maintaining design systems


The Perks
  • Diverse team (team members are based in US, UK, Europe, Canada, LATAM)
  • Working with interesting clients in the technology space
  • Fully remote
  • A highly cooperative team that encourages professional growth and self-development
  • Salary is commensurate with experience and market-rate at the candidate's location


﻿To be considered, apply with your cover letter, CV, and portfolio.

title: Enfermeiro
description:
Vaga:

  • Enfermeiro(a) na Alemanha


Salário:

  • +R$14.500/mês - inicial


Localidade da preparação (estudo de alemão e documentação):

  • Sua cidade de residência, na modalidade remota


Localidade do trabalho:

  • Alemanha (Berlim, Munique ou outras cidades com demanda hospitalar — a definir conforme colocação)


Programa:

  • ENFERmanha - Enfermagem na Alemanha, da Sprache&Wissen


Requisitos:

  • Graduação em enfermagem (formado(a) ou cursando)
  • Documentação em dia para o visto (passaporte válido ou possibilidade de emitir).
  • Disponibilidade para estudar o idioma alemão
  • Critérios do sistema previdenciário alemão


Principais atividades (na Alemanha):

  • Cuidado direto ao paciente em ambiente hospitalar ou clínico
  • Administração de medicamentos e acompanhamento de tratamentos
  • Documentação clínica e comunicação com equipe multidisciplinar em alemão
  • Participação em plantões conforme escala do empregador


Quem é a Sprache&Wissen?

  • A Sprache&Wissen (S&W) é uma empresa fundada em 2020 por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora de alemão doutora pela UFMG. A S&W administra a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, vai capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 99,1%.


Informações úteis:

  • Você não precisa saber o idioma alemão para participar.
  • Você participa de um processo de seleção e, se aprovado(a), estuda alemão por até 2 anos, até atingir o nível B2 (intermediário completo).
  • Para aprender o idioma, estuda na maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, por condição acessível e com garantia (Valor atualizado no site:
  • Concluída a etapa de estudos, dentro dos requisitos do programa, a S&W te conecta com sua oportunidade profissional na Alemanha.


Etapas:

1. Cadastro no site

2. Triagem

3. Reunião com consultor(a) da S&W

4. Inscrição no programa

4. Curso de alemão (até o nível B2)

5. Conexão com empregador(es)

6. Emprego na Alemanha

title: SR Arquiteto de Soluções SAP FI-CO
description:
Aqui na Zallpy, tecnologia nasce de pessoas curiosas, colaborativas e com vontade de fazer bem feito. Se você gosta de ambientes onde existe espaço para perguntar, testar, aprender e evoluir junto, se liga nessa oportunidade!

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão

Na Zallpy, valorizamos um ambiente onde todas as pessoas possam ser quem são, com respeito, segurança e pertencimento. Incentivamos especialmente a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e garantimos um ambiente acessível, com adaptações e suporte ao longo da jornada.

Também encorajamos pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIA+ e profissionais de diferentes origens a se candidatarem.

Aqui, você pode ser quem é, em cada fase da sua jornada. Vem com a gente. 🚀

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar em um time que pensa grande, trabalha com atenção aos detalhes, parceria no dia a dia e responsabilidade compartilhada. Acreditamos em autonomia, troca entre diferentes experiências e soluções construídas em conjunto.

Por aqui, crescer significa compartilhar conhecimento, respeitar diferentes formas de pensar e construir relações de confiança enquanto entregamos tecnologia de qualidade.

Se você se identifica com esse jeito de trabalhar, vem somar com a gente.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar a definição da arquitetura funcional e técnica de soluções SAP end-to-end, envolvendo múltiplos módulos e integrações.
  • Atuar na concepção de soluções para projetos de implementação, evolução e migração para SAP S/4HANA.
  • Apoiar processos de pré-venda, contribuindo na elaboração de propostas técnicas, definição de soluções e estimativas de esforço.
  • Definir estratégias de integração entre ambientes SAP, sistemas legados e demais aplicações corporativas.
  • Avaliar impactos de mudanças, garantindo aderência à arquitetura corporativa e às melhores práticas do ecossistema SAP.

title: Bilingual Customer Service Agent
description:
Job Description: Monday to Saturday. 44 hours per week. PJ. NIGHT SHIFT.


We are looking for a remote Bilingual Customer Service Agent to handle inbound and outbound phone call and email communications in both languages. This role focuses on assisting customers with questions related to delivery, installation, scheduling, and general order support, as well as proactively reaching out to customers when needed.


Responsibilities:

  • - Answer inbound phone calls and respond to customer emails in both languages
  • - Make outbound phone calls and send emails to customers for follow-ups, confirmations, and updates
  • Route logistics
  • - Provide accurate information about delivery and installation timelines
  • - Schedule, confirm, and update appointments as needed
  • - Resolve customer questions and issues in a professional and timely manner
  • - Document interactions and update customer records accurately
  • - Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth service delivery


Requirements:

  • - Previous experience in customer service or call center support
  • - Fluent verbal and written communication skills in two languages
  • - Comfortable handling inbound and outbound calls and emails throughout the day
  • - Organized, detail-oriented, and reliable
  • - Ability to remain calm and professional in fast-paced situations
  • - Basic computer skills (email, scheduling systems, CRM preferred)


What we offer:

- Training and ongoing support

- Growth opportunities within the company.


Please submit your CV in English.

title: Analista de Gestão de Pessoas e Cultura
description:
Analista de Gestão de Pessoas e Cultura | SalesRock


Procuramos uma pessoa comunicativa, empática e estratégica para fortalecer nosso time de Gente e Gestão. Você será responsável por cultivar uma cultura inclusiva, impulsionar o engajamento e garantir que a jornada de cada colaborador na SalesRock seja incrível do onboarding ao desenvolvimento contínuo.


Suas Principais Responsabilidades


  • Liderar o processo de acolhimento e integração (onboarding) de novos talentos.
  • Planejar e executar ações contínuas de engajamento, clima organizacional e endomarketing.
  • Acompanhar a jornada do colaborador através de pesquisas de clima, reuniões de 1-on-1 e entrevistas de desligamento.
  • Dar suporte no desenvolvimento e na implementação de programas de treinamento e liderança.
  • Ser um ponto de apoio ativo na mediação de conflitos e na promoção de um ambiente psicologicamente seguro e diverso.
  • Apoiar a mensuração de indicadores da área (rotatividade, absenteísmo, eNPS) para propor melhorias contínuas.


O Que Buscamos (Requisitos)


  • Experiência prévia na área de Recursos Humanos, com foco em Gestão de Pessoas, Cultura ou Desenvolvimento Organizacional.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, além de escuta ativa.
  • Habilidade para transitar entre a execução operacional e a análise estratégica de cultura.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de gerenciar projetos internos de forma autônoma.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência prévia no segmento de tecnologia ou startups.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de avaliação de desempenho e PDI (Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual).


O Que Oferecemos


  • Modelo de trabalho
  • Salário compatível com o mercado.
  • Ambiente dinâmico com oportunidade real de impacto na cultura da empresa.

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, Social content and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Arquiteto de Soluções SAP FInance
description:
Responsável por definir e governar a arquitetura E2E das soluções financeiras e fiscais no SAP S/4HANA, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções escaláveis, seguras, integradas e alinhadas aos princípios de SAP Clean Core.

Atuará principalmente com SAP FI, FSCM e CO, garantindo integração com MM, SD, PP, MDG, Tesouraria, Impostos e Compras. Também será responsável por orientar integrações via SAP CPI/PI-PO, APIs, IDocs e BAPIs, avaliar riscos técnicos, reduzir customizações e direcionar extensões por meio do SAP BTP.

Trabalhará em parceria com Product Owners, Tech Leads, GPOs e áreas de negócio, participando da governança de arquitetura, documentação técnica, análise de incidentes e mentoria das equipes.


Requisitos principais:

  • Experiência como Arquiteto de Soluções SAP Finance;
  • Participação em pelo menos uma implementação completa;
  • Domínio de SAP S/4HANA Finance, FI, FSCM e CO;
  • Conhecimento de ACDOCA, New GL, Asset Accounting e contabilidade paralela;
  • Experiência com integrações SAP CPI/PI-PO, APIs, IDocs e BAPIs;
  • Conhecimento em Clean Core, SAP BTP, SAFe, Jira e ServiceNow;
  • Certificação SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI/CO) obrigatória;
  • Certificações em Impostos, MDG, Tesouraria ou SAP BTP como diferenciais.

title: Analista de Projetos Sênior (Engenharia)
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Acompanhar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento, análise e validação de projetos de engenharia de saneamento.
  • Revisar e conduzir projetos executivos de engenharia.
  • Elaborar e revisar escopos técnicos, termos de referência e especificações para contratação de projetos.
  • Realizar análise crítica de soluções técnicas, garantindo aderência a normas, diretrizes da companhia e viabilidade operacional.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar cronogramas físico-financeiros de projetos de engenharia.
  • Apoiar a priorização e planejamento do portfólio de investimentos (CAPEX).
  • Conduzir reuniões técnicas com áreas internas, projetistas e fornecedores.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e executivos para a gestão.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Engenharia Civil, Ambiental, Sanitária ou áreas semelhantes.
  • Experiência em projetos de infraestrutura de saneamento ou obras de médio/grande porte.
  • Experiência prática em projetos e/ou interface com projetistas.
  • Conhecimento em dimensionamento de sistemas de água e esgoto.
  • Familiaridade com softwares de desenvolvimento de projetos (AutoCAD, Revit, BIM ou correlatas).


Informações adicionais

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 25.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Organizational Change Management
description:
Altimetrik is a leading digital business enablement company. Our agile professionals and engineering teams craft innovative solutions that drive transformation and growth for businesses worldwide.


We are looking for an experienced Organizational Change Management (OCM) Lead to support a large-scale transformation program, with a primary focus on Brazil and collaboration across regional and global teams.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Strong experience in Organizational Change Management (OCM) , ideally within large-scale transformation programs.
  • Previous experience as an OCM Lead, Change Management Lead, Senior Change Manager , or similar role.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute change management strategies, plans, and roadmaps .
  • Experience with stakeholder management, change impact assessments, readiness, adoption, and risk mitigation .
  • Experience working with regional and global teams in complex organizations.
  • Experience with ERP/SAP or enterprise transformation programs is highly desirable.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English are required.
  • Must be based in Brazil.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the timely and high-quality execution of the OCM methodology, roadmap, and deliverables for Brazil and the ACC region.
  • Develop and manage detailed OCM plans and activities aligned with the overall transformation roadmap.
  • Provide weekly status reporting on OCM deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and progress.
  • Identify and manage organizational change risks , defining appropriate mitigation actions.
  • Support local teams in identifying and addressing country-specific change and adoption risks.
  • Engage key stakeholders and support organizational readiness and adoption throughout the transformation.


Location: Brazil.

Contract Type: Contractor.

Compensation: USD $6,500/month.

️ Time Off: 15 vacation days per year.


If you have experience leading organizational change in complex transformation environments and are interested in a contractor opportunity with regional and global exposure, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Parceiro de negócios
description:
Parceiro(a) de Negócios | AgroBusca®Sobre a oportunidade

No agro, a gente sabe que bons negócios começam com uma boa conversa, confiança e vontade de construir junto.

A AgroBusca está recebendo solicitações de clientes de várias regiões do Brasil e está formando um time de parceiros apaixonados pelo agronegócio, por tecnologia e por ajudar pessoas. Procuramos alguém com iniciativa, boa comunicação e vontade de representar a AgroBusca na sua cidade ou região.

Não buscamos apenas alguém para vender. Buscamos um parceiro capaz de ouvir, entender a realidade de cada cliente e construir relacionamentos duradouros.

O que você fará

Como Parceiro(a) de Negócios AgroBusca, você atuará no desenvolvimento de novos negócios e no relacionamento com clientes e parceiros do setor agro. Acompanhará as oportunidades desde o primeiro contato até a conclusão da negociação, sempre buscando entender as necessidades do mercado e oferecer soluções adequadas ao portfólio da empresa.

No dia a dia, suas principais atividades serão:

  • Prospectar e desenvolver novos clientes e parceiros no setor agro.
  • Identificar demandas e oportunidades na sua cidade ou região.
  • Apresentar as soluções da AgroBusca de forma consultiva e clara.
  • Participar de negociações e acompanhar cada oportunidade até a conclusão.
  • Cultivar relacionamentos de longo prazo com clientes e parceiros.
  • Acompanhar os resultados comerciais e contribuir para a satisfação dos envolvidos.
  • Mapear regiões, culturas e segmentos prioritários.
  • Apoiar ações comerciais, relacionamento e marketing.
  • Compartilhar percepções do mercado e sugestões para aprimorar produtos e serviços.
O que esperamos de você

Estamos procurando uma pessoa comunicativa, responsável e com espírito de parceria. Alguém que goste de conversar, tenha facilidade para criar vínculos e entenda que, no agro, cada região tem sua realidade e merece ser tratada com atenção.

É importante ter:

  • Experiência com vendas, desenvolvimento de negócios, representação comercial ou parcerias.
  • Vivência no agronegócio ou em segmentos relacionados. Conhecer produtores, cooperativas, revendas, empresas de insumos ou outros participantes da cadeia será um diferencial.
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de negociação e habilidade para apresentar propostas de valor.
  • Perfil consultivo, com capacidade de ouvir, compreender necessidades e propor soluções.
  • Organização, autonomia e disciplina para trabalhar de forma remota.

title: Analista de Processos Pleno
description:
Cargo: Analista de Processos Pleno

Local: Centro, São José dos Pinhais - PR

Regime: 5 vezes por semana presencial Horário: (Segunda a Sexta das 8:00 as 18:00) - 44 HORAS SEMANAIS Contrato por 6 meses renovável por mais 6 meses podendo ter continuidade dependendo do desempenho do profissional.

Tipo de contrato: Cooperado

Segmento: Empresa de Logística com 25 unidades no Brasil.


Objetivo do Cargo:

  • Atuar como suporte estratégico aos Analistas Seniores na condução de projetos de melhoria contínua, realizando análises de causa raiz, estruturando soluções e garantindo o cumprimento das metas de produtividade e eficiência operacional nos processos de logística e transporte.


• Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar o ciclo completo de Relatórios A3, desde o diagnóstico até a verificação da eficácia, nos processos de logística e transporte.
  • Conduzir análises de causa raiz utilizando ferramentas de qualidade (Ishikawa, 5 Porquês, Pareto).
  • Desenhar fluxos de estado futuro (To-Be) e identificar oportunidades de redução de desperdícios nos processos de logística e transporte.
  • Gerir cronogramas de projetos de média complexidade seguindo o ciclo PDCA, na área de Logística e Transporte.
  • Estruturar dashboards e visões analíticas para monitoramento de KPIs e suporte à tomada de decisão. o Realizar cronoanalises o Validar a eficácia dos novos padrões e treinar as equipes operacionais.
  • Substituir ou representar os Analistas Seniores em frentes específicas de projetos estratégicos.


• Requisitos:

  • Experiência no setor de Logística e Transportes.
  • Superior completo (Engenharias, Logística, Administração ou áreas correlatas).
  • Desejável certificação Green Belt ou Black Belt.
  • Excel Avançado e forte capacidade analítica de dados.
  • Experiência em metodologias Lean Manufacturing / Six Sigma.
  • Perfil proativo, com foco em resultados e boa comunicação para interface com diferentes áreas

title: SAP Specialist Architect  - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:


At Aubay Portugal, we work daily with some of the largest organisations across sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications and energy, helping to build and evolve critical systems that support millions of users. We have been in Portugal since 2007 and are part of an international

group with a presence in several European countries.

More than technology, we build close relationships and deliver real-impact projects.


What are we looking for?

  • 5+ years of professional experience working with SAP;
  • • Strong and broad knowledge of SAP solutions, architecture and platforms;
  • • Proven experience as a SAP Architect / Platform Expert, contributing to technical decisions and solution design;
  • • Strong understanding of SAP architecture, integrations, components and platform interactions;
  • • Ability to analyse complex requirements and translate them into scalable and sustainable SAP solutions;
  • • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and business teams;
  • Fluent English is mandatory;
  • Experience working in international environments is highly valued;
  • The focus is on architecture, technical expertise, platform knowledge and solution guidance;
  • Alignment with our corporate culture and a commitment to integrity and ethics are highly valued;
  • Strong customer focus, teamwork, task prioritisation, and daily commitment are highly appreciated;
  • Candidates must be based in Brazil;
  • Availability and willingness to relocate to Portugal (mandatory).



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: Hybrid based in Portugal.



What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.



Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Process and Automation Consultant (3 months)
description:
We are seeking a Process and Automation Consultant – RPA Specialist to join a three‑month advisory engagement that supports the migration of the core pricing system. The consultant will own the end‑to‑end documentation of current pricing and agreement processes, uncover manual pain points , and design automation‑ready future‑state workflows. The role reports to the engagement lead and works closely with operational teams , the client’s internal stakeholders, and external implementation vendors.

Key Responsibilities

Document current‑state end‑to‑end pricing and agreement processes, including handoffs, exception paths, and workarounds. Quantify manual effort, cycle times, rework, and error rates using available data sources. Conduct structured process‑discovery workshops with operational teams to surface bottlenecks and improvement ideas. Identify and evaluate automation opportunities (RPA, workflow orchestration, rules‑based validation) and assess their long‑term viability. Design future‑state workflow alternatives that support agreement intake, validation, approval, and publication. Prioritize automation and redesign initiatives with effort, impact, and risk estimates. Distinguish automation that resolves root causes from automation that merely masks underlying process defects. Produce validated documentation and present findings to senior stakeholders for decision‑making.

✅ Job Requirements

Minimum 6 years of experience in business process analysis, process improvement, or intelligent‑automation consulting. Advanced English proficiency (C1 level) with strong written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to create process maps using BPMN, value‑stream mapping, SIPOC, or comparable

techniques. Hands‑on experience delivering RPA solutions with platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or similar. Demonstrated capability to lead and facilitate structured workshops with cross‑functional operational teams. Strong analytical skills to quantify manual effort, cycle times, and error rates.

Preferred Skills

Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification. Direct experience in pricing, rebates, or order‑to‑cash operations. Exposure to process‑mining tools such as Celonis or comparable solutions. Familiarity with workflow‑orchestration platforms (e.g., Camunda, Microsoft Power Automate).

title: Engenheiro(a) de Valor (Pré-Vendas)
description:
Procuramos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Valor para atuar com foco em pré-vendas, sendo responsável por conduzir demonstrações técnicas, desenvolver apresentações comerciais e realizar Provas de Conceito (POCs), contribuindo diretamente para o encanto dos clientes e a aceleração de novos negócios da empresa.


A ASIS é uma empresa jovem focada em inteligência tributária e contábil. Revolucionamos o mercado como a primeira Tax Tech da América Latina, atuando em todo território nacional para atender diversos segmentos e portes empresariais. Hoje contamos com um software tributário #16em1, uma verdadeira nuvem de conhecimento fiscal! Demais, não é mesmo? ✅

Aqui recebemos muito bem os novos talentos, pois acreditamos que a nossa maior força está nas pessoas! Somos simplesmente a p a i x o n a d o s por inovação, então ter um time que nos ajude a continuar construindo um ambiente leve, descontraído, dinâmico e motivador faz parte da nossa cultura


Os pilares da ASIS estão baseados em crescimento e aprendizagem constante, desenvolvimento de pessoas, meritocracia, sucesso do cliente, foco em talentos da casa, autonomia, excelência na execução de projetos e entrega de resultados.


🧑 🦽Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis para pessoas com deficiência!

Que tal se juntar ao nosso time e embarcar nessa jornada com a gente?


Modelo de Trabalho:

• Residindo em SP: 100% presencial em nosso escritório em Pinheiros/SP.

• Residindo em outros estados: 100% remoto.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Conduzir apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de soluções com foco em gerar valor para o cliente, com a construção de modelos de ROI (Retorno sobre Investimento) e payback para o cliente, evidenciando os benefícios financeiros, redução de riscos e aumento da competitividade a serem alcançados com a implementação;
  • Executar Provas de Conceito (POCs) e apoiar na abertura e desenvolvimento de novos negócios;
  • Apoiar executivos na condução de reuniões (presenciais ou remotas) e no avanço de oportunidades no pipeline;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento técnico de forma estruturada, criando e mantendo repositórios de melhores práticas e casos de sucesso reutilizáveis;
  • Proximidade com time de produtos e CS para geração de uma jornada leve e prazerosa para os clientes pós-aquisição;
  • Registrar e gerenciar oportunidades no CRM (Ploomes);
  • Analisar o pipeline de vendas e propor estratégias para alcance de resultados de longo prazo.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência técnica e comercial com venda de softwares SaaS;
  • Conhecimento sólido em ecossistema fiscal e contábil, com atualização constante sobre os impactos e desdobramentos da Reforma Tributária;
  • Vivência e atuação com o mercado corporativo de médio e grande porte;
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal, escrita e escuta ativa;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Atuação no modelo presencial em São Paulo/SP (para candidatos da região) ou 100% remoto para candidatos de demais estados;
  • Possuir CNH cat. B.


Diferenciais:

  • Possuir veículo próprio;
  • Experiência com utilização de CRM;
  • Vivência prévia no segmento de softwares ERP.


BENEFÍCIOS QUE VÃO ALÉM DA JORNADA

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação: R$ 990,00/mês;
  • Vale Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível;
  • Assistência Médica SulAmérica sem coparticipação e sem desconto para o colaborador;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade estendida;
  • Parceria Credencial Plena SESC;
  • TotalPass;
  • Plataforma de saúde mental e bem-estar;
  • Day Off de Aniversário;
  • Presentes e Mimos em datas comemorativas.
